name: Lesante Blu Exclusive Beach Resort
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary on Zakynthos feels like a slice of heaven suspended between azure sky and crystalline waters, where luxury meets the untamed beauty of the Ionian Sea.
whats_special: Perched dramatically on Tsilivi's clifftops, this Leading Hotels property offers unobstructed views of the legendary shipwreck beach area and sits just minutes from Zakynthos' famous turtle nesting grounds at Laganas Bay. The resort's infinity pools seem to merge seamlessly with the Ionian horizon, creating an optical illusion that's pure Instagram gold.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's cliffside restaurant during the full moon - the combination of moonlight reflecting off the water and the distant silhouette of Kefalonia creates an unforgettable romantic backdrop.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary boat trip to the world-famous Navagio Beach (Shipwreck Beach) - one of the most photographed beaches globally. Also, venture to nearby Keri Caves for snorkeling among hidden underwater grottos, and catch the legendary Zakynthos sunset from Kampi village, just 20 minutes away.
pros: Exclusive beachfront location with pristine private beach access
Luxury all-suite accommodations with premium amenities
Stunning Mediterranean views and sophisticated design
